title: ValidationReport
description: Output of data-validation. Staged, deterministic source-vs-target comparison (row counts -> hash aggregates -> column aggregates -> bounded row-level diff), plus LLM root-cause diagnosis on discrepancies found. Suggestions only -- data-validation never applies remediation.

platform.description: e.g. 'databricks', 'snowflake', 'sql_server'. Cross-platform comparisons are supported; type_coercion_map is required when source.platform != target.platform.

type_coercion_map.description: Required (non-null) when source.platform != target.platform: how each compared column's type was coerced to a common comparable type before hashing.

normalization_applied.description: Normalization is mandatory before hashing to avoid the usual false-positive sources.

ordering.description: e.g. 'sorted by declared or inferred key columns prior to row hashing'.

nulls.description: e.g. 'NULL coerced to a fixed sentinel distinct from any valid value prior to hashing'.

floats.description: e.g. 'rounded to 6 decimal places before hashing'.

timezones.description: e.g. 'all timestamps normalized to UTC before hashing'.

stages.description: Executed in order; later stages only run if the prior stage found a discrepancy (or was forced). Digging deeper only as needed keeps cost down.

stopped_here.description: True if this stage matched (no discrepancy) and the comparison stopped without going deeper.

result.description: Stage-specific deterministic result, e.g. {source_count, target_count} or {source_hash, target_hash, match}.

row_cap.description: Non-null only for the row_level_diff stage: the maximum rows pulled for line-by-line comparison.

kind.description: missing_from_target: key present in source, absent in target. extra_in_target: present in target, absent in source. changed: same key both sides, values differ.

key.description: The candidate/declared key column values identifying the specific row this discrepancy is about (e.g. {"order_id": 5230, "line_number": 1}). Lets a reader identify which row without opening sample_diff_ref.

sample_diff_ref.description: Pointer (path within output_dir) to the bounded, redacted full-row diff detail for this key, when the run wrote one. Null is fine for a small run where the row detail is cheap to regenerate; never inline raw client rows beyond the configured cap directly into this field.

suggested_fix.description: A suggestion only; never applied by this skill.

known_acceptable_differences_excluded.description: Differences explicitly declared acceptable (e.g. by toolkit.yaml or in-run config) and therefore excluded from discrepancies[] even though the deterministic comparison found them.

match.description: True if source and target are equivalent after normalization and excluding known-acceptable differences.
